children: Avalon’s third-quarter revenue decreased year over year, while earnings attributable to common shareholders increased. Lower waste-management revenue, mainly from fewer event work projects, was partly offset by growth in golf and related operations; improved golf activity and cost-cutting efforts supported segment income.
¹ Reported as “Total net operating revenues”. ² Reported as “Net income attributable to Avalon Holdings Corporation common shareholders”.
: Third-quarter segment revenue fell to $11.1M from $12.9M, mainly as event work projects declined.
: Waste brokerage continuous-work revenue rose to $7.3M from $6.9M; event work revenue fell to $2.7M from $5.3M.
: Segment revenue increased to $13.2M from $12.8M; segment pretax income rose to $2.9M from $1.9M.
: Room revenue increased to $3.2M from $2.9M, reflecting higher average daily rates and occupancy.
